features.expected: Import a Blender model with multiple source materials and an external texture into this scratch content tree.

features.expected: Call public primitive and mesh simplification APIs with a nontrivial LOD ratio.
features.actual: CityApiProbe built and its assertion mesh-tools-simplify-lod passed: sphere source had indices and SimplifyMesh at TargetRatio=.45 returned nonempty fewer triangles.

features.expected: Assign a project material to an imported model and verify the saved slot override.
features.actual: project.scene material and /materialSlots/0 property steps both returned status 0; saved scene retained /Game/Materials/WarmStone.mat for Suzanne slot 0, with slot 1 still pointing to its imported material.

features.actual: render.point-shadows exited 2 and returned ok=false with X3000 syntax error and X3004 undeclared UnexpectedFunction at Bad.hlsl line 1; no misleading GPU pass was reported.

features.actual: Controlled fresh-process A/B after current BasicSky fix: gradient SHA ECB904FF66AC3D180DD4D1BCE1287EEAE7F4A176A453F067C33E0E1C9F257968; Studio 38EB1C85CD05D8C4B04B1E662D26EBFCF6B093FA84CAA91A88472A6584C3F1C4; Space 3B1EDB15B39D8BD03C7279245B650E65A629D917A0847BC46EA27EDE76C7E093. Probe logs say hasCubeMap false for gradient and true for both presets. All outputs visibly differ.

features.expected: A write-locked graph sidecar must make Save fail without discarding dirty state; Revert should clear it.
features.actual: The actual graph editor returned save accepted=false and dirty=true with permission-denied dialog, then Revert accepted=true and dirty=false.

features.expected: Edit an imported material slot, undo/redo, save and reopen the scene.
features.actual: Slot 0 edit, Undo, Redo, Save and Load steps each returned status 0; the saved scene records the expected per-slot material.

features.expected: Render an imported UV chart/material from an overhead view and observe its texture.
features.actual: The imported UV material loaded BaseColor_0.png (64x64); overhead XZ-plane preview shows the chart color block, center RGB [2,2,57], frame SHA 01fb5ee557e0d5aef863d83b67a5dad39df6efc9534c17d06c78726f0c8f7b22.

features.expected: Generate a tangent basis on a regular quad with valid UVs.
features.actual: All four vertices returned tangent [1,0,0,1].

features.expected: Handle degenerate UV triangles with finite fallback tangent values.
features.actual: All four outputs remained finite and returned fallback [0,1,0,0] for the degenerate fixture.

features.expected: Render a normal-mapped material in a visible GPU setup; A/B mirrored UV and negative scale.
features.actual: With camera above the XZ plane and render.twoSided=true, RTX 4070 frames were visible and distinct: positive dd4a4fdde26493df90224580861bcb97c456ba65596dc0b04274ea5ed58dd1a9, negative-X 88031416152aaa1546ce2941a43b559a18fbaad7f0913d5d88d3f0f191f541a2, negative-Z cce8cbc361a123507ed81ca58a6d7644e0fc9550b6019118215d8566a1e71900.

features.expected: Negative-X and negative-Z world reflections should preserve a valid normal-map response in a two-sided material.
features.actual: Both reflected frames rendered non-background color and produced hashes different from positive; tangents remained finite in all four diagnostic vertices.

features.expected: Capture/restore a reflected mesh and retain its transform/tangent basis.
features.actual: Negative-X SaveGame round-trip returned restored=true and transientMaterialRebound=true; restored tangent basis was reported by render.mesh.

features.expected: Reject graph node-count overflow and keep all 121 unique D3D texture slots (t6..t127 except reserved t32) unique.
features.actual: Before fix a 122-node graph emitted duplicate t127. After fix, 122 Texture2D nodes were rejected with maximum 121 and graph remained unchanged; 121 nodes were accepted, emitted 121 unique registers t6..t127 excluding t32, for both explicit boundary slots and int32-max input values.

features.expected: Run a separately parameterized session with 3 scenes and deterministic ticking, then stop it.
features.actual: session.lifecycle completed ready=3, closing=3, elapsed≈0.6s, ticks=15, running=false.

features.expected: Move a character through the public SDK and confirm its actual position delta.
features.actual: CityApiProbe assertion character-move-world passed; Move({1,0,0},.25) at speed 5 changed local X by 1.25.

features.expected: Possess the character and camera with the public controller API.
features.actual: CharacterController possession assertion passed and returned the same character pointer/id.

features.expected: Create an orthographic camera and query rays through its actual screen matrix.
features.actual: Camera was added as Gameplay.Camera; own orthographic screen-ray request succeeded with parallel direction and displaced origin.

features.expected: Query a screen ray and raycast it against the live scene.
features.actual: In the game probe, ScreenPointToRay returned Success and RaycastScreen returned Hit (component id 7); standalone trace.raycast request also hit its triangle.

features.expected: Run the real particle component on GPU and record output at controlled simulation checkpoints.
features.actual: RTX 4070 render.particles on/off frames executed 18 and 54 cumulative steps with dispatch/instance counts and saved outputs.

features.expected: Collision-on/off A/B should match before contact and diverge after particle-floor contact.
features.actual: At step 18 on/off SHA matched 3c19b064…a2ab37; at step 54 on=7213d00b…c038 and off=d83f7b…4509; inspected on frame had a red particle at floor and off had none.

features.expected: Send press/release through project.input to an actual project HUD button and observe its handler.
features.actual: project.input ran 7 frames; click at (40,32) invoked callback and appended `hud-button-clicked` to the project log.

features.expected: Change Deferred/VSync/AA settings and read them back from the runtime game.
features.actual: Own public SDK assertions confirmed Deferred, VSync=false and AA=1; standalone settings commandlet also returned requested values.

features.expected: Exercise host asset resolution and local virtual-file mount/write/read/stat/unmount.
features.actual: Host resolved /Game/Audio/probe.wav; local VFS mount and write/read/stat/unmount assertions all passed; exported package includes relative WAV content.

features.expected: Export current project with relative content/module paths and verify runtime mounts exported Game/Content and completes standalone smoke.
features.actual: Fresh CityProbeExportFinal has content=Content, module=Binaries/Game.dll, startupScene=Content/Scenes/Continuation.scene.json. GameSmoke mounted /Game to the export staging Game/Content, first read /Game model via module, ran 3 updates and stopped. ProjectGame.cpp has no __FILE__; it resolves audio through EngineModuleVfs and writes diagnostic frames under env/default temp. Manual source-folder removal was not run.

features.expected: Compile and run a small project using public SDK examples for settings, components, meshes, VFS, tracing, audio and HUD.
features.actual: CityApiProbe built against explicit current Runtime SDK and executed feature assertions through real game initialization/input.

features.expected: Decode a project WAV and consume all frames.
features.actual: WavDecoder opened the fixture and decoded all 800 frames; project WAV imports as 1644 bytes.

features.expected: Confirm runtime 2D playback starts and can be heard.
features.actual: AudioEngine returned accepted=true for Play2D on a valid sound handle; no listening/audible output check was performed.

features.expected: Confirm runtime 3D playback starts with an emitter at a nonzero position and can be heard.
features.actual: AudioEngine returned accepted=true for Play3D with emitter position [2,0,0]; no listening/spatial audibility check was performed.

features.expected: Exercise stream lifecycle including multiple updates and stop; verify audible output.
features.actual: Stream handle accepted; three updates ran with 10ms spacing, StopStream issued and a final Update ran. Audio was not listened to.

features.expected: Use a custom GameSubsystem with startup, per-frame Tick and shutdown callbacks in a real session.
features.actual: Parameterized session ran 3 scenes and 5 frames each at dt=.04: the custom subsystem observed ready=3, ticks=15, closing=3; after Stop running=false and elapsed=0.599999964s.
